name: How long does a typical door replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door replacement project varies depending on the type of door and the complexity of the installation. A standard pre-hung exterior door replacement can often be completed within a single day. However, custom doors, alterations to the door frame, or unexpected structural issues can extend the timeline. Interior door replacements are generally quicker, sometimes taking only a few hours per door. Our team will provide a more precise estimate after assessing your specific project requirements during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard door replacements take one day, but custom doors or frame alterations can extend the timeline. Interior doors are usually quicker.
